source_text: Drishti 2024 is one of the Flagship Events of College of Engineering Trivandrum (CET). It is a technical fest consisting of various events like Workshops, Hackathons, Pro-shows, and Expos. Drishti is not conducted every year; it was previously conducted in 2022, and then in 2024, with no edition in 2023 or 2025. Drishti 2024 was a marvelous event spanning 3 complete days: April 5, 6, and 7, 2024.
